notes.title: Firebird is part of The Storyteller's Festival + livestream
notes.content:
Hello adventurers, 

Firebird is above all, a story built around a road trip. This makes the game a good match for The Storyteller's Festival!

For this occasion, the game is at 30% off until February 4!

Also, if you want a quick overview of the game, we will broadcast a pre-recorded gameplay session with Chloé (Marketing Manager at Ludogram) and FibreTigre (Writer of Firebird). This live stream will be showcased on January 30 at 1:00 pm (PST) or 10:00 pm (UTC+1).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40851551/3bb5a335497fbb478b931f6330a58d094779c86e.gif

Feel free to join our Discord server to tell us about your favorite part of the game!

notes.title: Thank you & new demo 🚚
notes.content:
Hello, Adventurers!

First of all, a big thank you to everyone who has bought, supported, streamed and reviewed Firebird! We are happy to read your feedback and hope you had a good time on the road of myths & magic.

If you want to support us, you can leave a positive review on Steam to let us know what was your favorite parts of the game!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40851551/04cb981180a6b3833d6ffd133dd4e3ac8e154c3d.png

A new demo on the page

We have decided to update the demo because the previous demo no longer represented the whole game experience.


 We added parts of the game that reflected the “icy road trip” experience better
 Firebird also puts the accent on myths and legends, so you will meet a few of the colorful characters
 You are able to choose destinations that will lead you to more or less dangerous outcomes!


To the new people who just found out about the game, we hope you’ll want to have a longer road trip with this short preview of the game! ❄️

You can join our Discord server if you want to share your thoughts about it!

notes.title: Hotfix 1.5.4
notes.content:
Hello, Adventurers!

We continue to update a few aspects of the game thanks to your feedback.

Information: this fix impacts the full game and the current demo.

Here is the update on today's patch:

 Fixed the localization issue in the settings that were staying in French even though it was swapped to English.

notes.title: Hotfix 1.5.3
notes.content:
Hello adventurers!

Thanks to your precious feedback, we have fixed the following aspects:

 Untriggered achievements: "The end of the journey" and "Explorer" are showing now.
Regarding the "Explorer" achievement:
- Either it is detected when you start a new game if you explored everything on the map in previous runs, and will also unlock "The end of the journey" and "Chernobog"
- Or if you have not unlocked "Explorer" yet, "The end of the journey" and "Chernobog" will be unlocked normally when you end the game.
 Typographic corrections in French
 Fixed the screen reader activation that was not automatically launched if the demo was not downloaded. Also, the screen reader will automatically speak after this update if you launch the game again.

notes.title: Firebird is OUT NOW! + developer livestream tomorrow
notes.content:
Hi Adventurers!

Great news for you today! Our magical road trip Firebird is HERE!

Are you ready to embark on a rich and folkloric adventure aboard your Firebird? Are you ready to switch back and forth between myth and reality? All your choices will be important to your smooth progress in the Great North, without forgetting resource management!

Check out the trailer and its Audio Described version :

[previewyoutube=S4XQramBB3Y;full][/previewyoutube]

Meet Mariska and Vassilissa

Embark with Mariska and Vassilissa aboard the Firebird, in their road trip in the Great North in search of a lost village, prey to the dangers of these sacred lands.

These two young women are very different and yet! Mariska, a convoy driver in her Firebird truck, travels the snowy roads to survive. Vassilissa is trying to save her village by asking Mariska for help. Their history makes them who they are, with their own beliefs.

Their unexpected friendship will be put to the test during their journey aboard the Firebird.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40851551/2aacf2c67071aa867f2c3190c119878f6c4a1330.gif

Explore magical landscapes

You can explore the snowy landscapes of the Great North, from the industrial city of Norislk to the most sacred lands hiding legendary creatures.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40851551/3bb5a335497fbb478b931f6330a58d094779c86e.gif

Keep a close eye on your truck

Travel around the steppes of the Great North with your truck. Pay attention to its condition and the gas, and choose the best route. Will you manage to get your truck to its destination without succumbing to the dangers of this hostile land?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40851551/f246701420ba45c80b558ce26ac80ad2b683d548.gif

Firebird launch discount

To celebrate this magical event, Firebird has a -20% launch discount! For those, who haven’t joined the road trip yet, it is time to embark!

Also, we plan to stream the game in French tomorrow, August 3 at 5:00 pm (CET) on FibreTigre's channel. Emmanuel, Narrative Designer at Ludogram and FibreTigre, writer of Firebird, will play the game and answer your questions!

We want to say thank you to all of you who are with us on this long trip alongside 💗

To support us, you can spread the word about the game and leave a positive review on Steam and tell us what you enjoyed during your icy road trip ❄

And don't forget to join our Discord server to share your thoughts about the game with us 💙

notes.title: Demo accessibility update | July 28th 2023
notes.content:
Hello Adventurers,

In previous Steam news, we mentioned that Firebird will be accessible to visually-impaired people and added a few accessibility features.

We added a new addition to these features and wanted to inform you about it.

Here is what we originally announced as accessibility features:

 Screen reader detection on the first launch
- Menu, dialogues, narrations, map
 Able/Disable scenery shaking
 Able/Disable characters shaking
 Able/Disable text shaking
 Able/Disable transparency
 Able/Disable particles


Regarding the new feature, you'll be now able to play with one hand with a keyboard.

We'd be happy to read your thoughts about these features on our social accounts or the Steam forum!

notes.title: July Devlog | Firebird will be accessible to visually-impaired people!
notes.content:
Hello adventurers,

Last month, we mentioned during the Steam Next Fest news that the demo was accessible for visually-impaired people. We have good news! Not only it was implemented in the demo, but so it will be in the full game!

Why did we make this choice?
The accessibility issue in video games is still underrated. LudAccess, which specializes in visually-impaired issues in games, visited us earlier this year. Since we love to learn new things, we have decided to gain new skills to extend the audience of this and our future games.

What does this change in the game settings?

 Screen reader detection on the first launch
- Menu, dialogues, narrations, map
- Set and character descriptions, credits and video descriptions (WIP)
 Able/Disable scenery shaking
 Able/Disable characters shaking
 Able/Disable text shaking
 Able/Disable transparency
 Able/Disable particles

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40851551/1f162aa7d2961c9ed478903c4cfdb9f5c731cc70.gif

We would like to know what you think about these features, so if you ever use them once the game is out, feel free to share your thoughts on our social accounts!

notes.title: Firebird takes part in the Steam Next Fest + developer livestream ❄🚚
notes.content:
Hello, Adventurers!

We’re delighted to announce that Firebird will participate in this Steam Next Fest from June 19th to 26th! Prepare for a wave of freshness during the hot summer. ❄

What’s new in this demo?
For this demo, we have added accessibility features for visually-impaired people! This is a new experience for us so we can gain knowledge to implement this feature in our future games.

Developer livestream

During the Next Fest, we’ll stream a pre-recorded livestream on June 20th at 7:00 pm (CEST) with Chloé, Marketing Manager at Ludogram and FibreTigre, writer of Firebird. Don’t miss out on this opportunity to have a first preview of the game!

Thank you for your support and don’t miss out on all of the game news by joining our Discord server! 🚚
